security(v1-pro): redact tenant secret in committed runtime-e2e EVIDENCE (#108)

The runtime-e2e for the V1 Pro proxy tools (#107) was writing the
full /api/v1/register response to EVIDENCE/<utc-ts>/register.json,
which contains the tenant's bcrypt-validated Basic-auth `secret`
field. EVIDENCE/ is committed into the public-mirrored repo, so
that secret leaked into git history. Caught in the post-merge
self-review audit the user prompted ("did self-review happen?").

fix: grep -c exit code bug causing "0\n0" REMAINING value

grep -c returns exit 1 when no matches found. With set -eo pipefail,
the | tail -1 || echo "0" pattern produced "0\n0" (tail output + echo
output concatenated), breaking the -eq 0 comparison and causing the
verdict to show "failure" even when 0 critical findings remained.

Fix: drop | tail -1 (unnecessary for grep -c), use || true instead.

concurrent client requests and the single upstream cli.js spawn. It does
not introduce, alter, or remove any endpoint, header, request field, or
response field that cli.js emits or expects — no client-observable wire
shape change.
